pages.text: Techguns machines run on Forge Energy (FE). Every tick a generator gives energy to the blocks next to it that accept it: a machine, an energy cell or a cable.$(br2)Place the generator against the machine or run a cable.
pages.title: Basics

pages.text: Generators only give energy. The energy cell and the energy bank take it on every side but the front and give it through the front.$(br2)Right clicking most power blocks tells how much they make and why it is less than the best.
For reference: presses and the chemical laboratory need 10-20 FE/t, the heaviest recipes up to 800 FE/t.$(br2)Generators that burn something stop burning while their buffer is full.
